Tests markdown output format via bytes extraction API

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from pathlib import Path
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput
from xberg._xberg import ExtractionConfig

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput.from_json("{\"bytes\":\"pdf/fake_memo.pdf\",\"config\":{\"output_format\":\"markdown\"},\"filename\":\"fake_memo.pdf\",\"kind\":\"bytes\",\"mime_type\":\"application/pdf\"}")
    config = ExtractionConfig.from_json("{\"output_format\":\"markdown\"}")
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)
    print(result.results[0].metadata.output_format)

asyncio.run(main())
```
